name: Popover
description: Anchors interactive content to a trigger without blocking the page.

when: Previews richer than a line of text
whenNot: Anything that must block the page (use Dialog)
Feedback the user does not act on (use Toast or Alert)
guidelines: Always give the user a visible way out
Pick a side that does not cover what the user just clicked
Add the arrow when the trigger is not obvious
Pass render={<Button />} (or a link) to Popover.Trigger and Popover.Close
accessibility: Focus is moved to popover content on open
Focus returns to trigger on close

examples.name: Default
examples.description: Title, body, and a close control.
examples.code:
<Popover>
  <Popover.Trigger render={<Button variant="soft" />}>Open Popover</Popover.Trigger>
  <Popover.Content>
    <Popover.Close />
    <Popover.Title>Popover Title</Popover.Title>
    <Popover.Description>
      This is a popover with some content. It can contain text, forms, or other elements.
    </Popover.Description>
  </Popover.Content>
</Popover>

examples.name: With Form
examples.description: Enough room to edit a value in place.
examples.code:
<Popover>
  <Popover.Trigger render={<Button variant="soft" />}>Edit Name</Popover.Trigger>
  <Popover.Content size="sm">
    <Popover.Close />
    <Popover.Title>Edit Name</Popover.Title>
    <Popover.Body>
      <Field>
        <Field.Label>Display Name</Field.Label>
        <Input placeholder="Enter name" />
      </Field>
    </Popover.Body>
    <Popover.Footer>
      <Popover.Close render={<Button variant="soft" size="sm" />}>Cancel</Popover.Close>
      <Button variant="solid" size="sm">Save</Button>
    </Popover.Footer>
  </Popover.Content>
</Popover>

examples.name: With Arrow
examples.description: The arrow ties the panel back to its trigger.
examples.code:
<Popover>
  <Popover.Trigger render={<Button variant="soft" />}>Info</Popover.Trigger>
  <Popover.Content arrow>
    <Popover.Title>Quick Tip</Popover.Title>
    <Popover.Description>
      This popover has an arrow pointing to its trigger element.
    </Popover.Description>
  </Popover.Content>
</Popover>

examples.name: Positions
examples.description: Flips to the opposite side when space runs out.
examples.code: }>Top Popover on top }>Bottom Popover on bottom

examples.name: Link Trigger
examples.description: render lets a link open it.
examples.code:
<Popover>
  <Popover.Trigger render={<a href="#popover-help" />}>Open help</Popover.Trigger>
  <Popover.Content size="sm">
    <Popover.Description>The trigger renders as a link through render.</Popover.Description>
  </Popover.Content>
</Popover>

relations.note: Use Tooltip for brief, non-interactive hints

propsSummary: modal: boolean - blocks page interaction (default: false)
Popover.Trigger, Popover.Close render: element - render a library control or a link
Popover.Content size: sm|md - width cap and inset (default: md)
Popover.Content side: top|bottom|left|right (default: bottom); align: start|center|end (default: center)
Popover.Content arrow: boolean - fill-only pointer (default: false)
Popover.Content anchor, positionMethod, container - position against another element or portal elsewhere
